title: Two-Factor Coverage Gap Audit
dataSources: Breach alerts (`breach:alert`), inbox stats (`inbox:stats`), cloud-drive usage (`clouddrive:usage`), certificate expiry (`certexpiry:check`).
app: Personal cybersecurity feeds — Have-I-Been-Pwned breach alerts, personal email/inbox stats, cloud-storage usage APIs, and personal TLS-certificate expiry checks — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=breach:alert event=account_inventory
| stats latest(mfa_enabled) as mfa, latest(importance) as importance by account
| where mfa="false" AND importance IN ("high","critical")
| sort importance
description: Lists your important accounts that still lack two-factor authentication, the biggest easy security win.
value: Enabling two-factor on your critical accounts blocks the vast majority of account takeovers; this shows exactly where it is missing.
implementation: Maintain an account inventory in `index=personal`; flag important accounts without two-factor.
visualization: Table of important accounts missing two-factor.
grandmaExplanation: It lists your important accounts that still lack a second login step, the easiest way to stay safe online.
